notes.title: Minor patch - 2024/10/04
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the first "big boss" wouldn't provide any rewards
 Fixed a bug where loading the game after getting a warp core, wouldn't show the correct number gathered
 Fixed a bug where the game might trigger a game over condition on load
 Fixed an issue with 16:10 resolutions
 Added a note next to the modifications panel, so players know they can click on it to change modifiers active

notes.title: Block Strategy Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hi All,

I've just released the first demo for Block Strategy over on my steam page. The demo includes a tutorial and the first 20-30 minutes of gameplay. 

I'm really excited for you guys to play it and to get some feedback over on discord here.

I've also uploaded a quick 4-5 minute video explaining the demo here.

As it's the first time releasing to the public there may be balance issues and potentially bugs, so please do let me know so I can fix them for Steam Next Fest in June!

To note: The demo map is much smaller and has much less to do than in the real game and the map and points of interest are fixed in the demo (but would be generated/ randomised in the real game).

All the best,
Marc
